title: Echo and Gravity
author: I. M. Crane
blurb: Beatrix Ishikawa, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
